description: Main window. The shell exposes only app commands (which need no capability entry) and Rust-to-UI events, so the UI's only core API is the event listener: listen for scanProgress/scanComplete/planVerified and unlisten on unmount. The rest of core:default — app, window, webview, menu, tray, image, resources and path — and the event bundle's emit/emit-to are deliberately not granted, because nothing in the shell calls them.
